question: Where does synchronous damped full-irrep BP fail to converge, or converge slowly, on the canonical two-dimensional Lab 002 geometries?
matched_inputs: Each paired arm receives the same canonical graph, physical edge error, m record, prior, schedule, and sampled full irrep R; the m-only arm ignores only R.
outcomes: mean absolute posterior shift from R
acceptance_gates: The scan uses the canonical Lab 002 square and honeycomb constructors with rough left/right and smooth transverse boundaries.
Exactly 128 independently seeded observations are evaluated with no adaptive extension.
The two arms are matched except for whether R enters the local likelihood.
Every cell reports convergence counts, iterations, residuals, and the R-induced posterior shift.
Any nonconvergence is reported as a diagnostic boundary rather than silently discarded or retuned.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen 128 observations. Do not tune damping, extend a difficult cell, or make a threshold/logical-performance claim in this transition.
censor_reason: The registered grid arithmetic was inconsistent: 2 lattices x 2 sizes x 2 groups x 4 rates x 8 seeds equals 256, not the registered total of 128. The runner asserted before writing any result; its in-memory evaluations are discarded.
